chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:

When Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام returned from Baghdad and proceeded to al-Madīnah, a daughter of his died at Fayd. So he buried her and ordered some of his mawālī to plaster her grave and to write her name on a tablet and place it in the grave.

key_terms.لَوْحٍ: a tablet or board for inscription
key_terms.مَوَالِيهِ: his affiliated servants or loyal followers
key_terms.يُجَصِّصَ: to plaster the grave with gypsum

ai.seo_question: What did Imām Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام do when his daughter died at Fayd?
ai.summary: This report narrates that Imām Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام buried his daughter at Fayd during his return from Baghdad to al-Madīnah. It also records his instruction to plaster her grave and place a tablet bearing her name in it, which relates to burial practice and funeral matters.
